# Version Role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:VersionRole`](gmeow-VersionRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/VersionRole>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/versions`](../../slices/versions.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A role or status that an entity holds within a version set according to an authority — a VALUE, never an [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) subclass. Standpoint-scoped: 'latest' according to a package registry may differ from 'latest' according to a downstream mirror. The seed list is an anchor, not a fence.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:VersionRole`](gmeow-VersionRole.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for membership roles — the named statuses (latest, stable, deprecated, yanked, …) referenced by [`gmeow:versionRole`](../properties/gmeow-versionRole.md), and the place to mint a new role individual when a domain needs one.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-role [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) subclasses or typing artifacts directly with a role; roles are individual values asserted through a standpoint-scoped membership, not essential types.

### How to use

- Reference the seeded individuals from [`gmeow:versionRole`](../properties/gmeow-versionRole.md), and extend the anchor list with new [`gmeow:VersionRole`](gmeow-VersionRole.md) individuals (label only) rather than subclasses when a lineage needs a role the seeds omit.

### Examples

- ex:roleArchived a [`gmeow:VersionRole`](gmeow-VersionRole.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "archived"@en.
